AP Holidays – Extremely unprofessional and disappointing experience
I am writing this review after waiting for 10 days since returning from Delhi. I checked out on 19th January 2026, and today is 30th January 2026. I waited intentionally, hoping I might feel differently with time, but the experience still feels equally disturbing—hence this honest review.
I stayed at this hotel from 15th to 19th January 2026.
We were a group of 8 people — 4 college students participating in a DTU hackathon and 4 parents.
Initially, we booked 3 rooms for 15th January:
2 rooms with 3 persons each (₹3000 per room)
1 room with 2 persons (₹2500)
We checked in around 9:00 PM. After staying the first night, we decided to continue our stay for 16th, 17th and 18th January.
👉 On the morning of 16th January, the reception was clearly informed that:
One room would be vacated
The remaining 2 rooms would have 2 persons each (₹2500 per room)
This was communicated clearly and well in advance.
Serious issues with billing & staff behavior
When we went to make payment on 17th January, the reception staff denied the above information, even though the details were available in their computer system.
No proper billing system
Bills were written manually
Staff claimed that when rooms are reduced, their system cannot generate proper bills
On questioning, the behavior turned rude, arrogant, and dismissive
Two people were present at the reception.
One identified himself as Ashish Pratap Singh / Ashish Kumar Singh, while the other refused to disclose his name.
Final settlement & shocking response
During the final payment:
One cup of tea was charged ₹69
A water bottle (MRP ₹20) was charged ₹49
When we questioned these inflated charges and the lack of billing transparency, the reception staff openly told us to “go to the consumer forum and file a case.”
Being asked to approach a consumer court instead of receiving a proper explanation or resolution reflects a complete lack of professionalism and accountability.
Overall experience
Zero professionalism
No transparency in billing
Extremely rude and irresponsible reception staff
Mental harassment, especially while staying with parents and students
❌ I would strongly NOT recommend this hotel to families, parents, or students who expect basic respect, honesty, and proper billing practices.
